title: Spicy Smoky Veggie Wrap
description: A flavorful and energizing vegetarian wrap filled with sautéed vegetables and served in a crispy whole wheat toast.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add a tablespoon of oil to the pan, then add the mushrooms and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
3. Add the red bell pepper and sauté for another 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the spinach and eggplant, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
5. Spread a tablespoon of hummus on each slice of whole wheat toast.
6. Assemble the wrap by placing the sautéed vegetables on top of the hummus.
8. Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
